newsitem.title: USA: U.S. imposes sanctions on Chinese entities.
newsitem.headline: U.S. imposes sanctions on Chinese entities.

text.p: The United States has imposed sanctions on several Chinese entities for transferring chemical weapons components to Iran, Secretary of State Madeleine Albright said on Thursday.

Testifying before a Senate subcommittee, Albright said: "There is no evidence the Chinese government was involved" in the transfers, which involved chemicals and other technology that could be used in chemical weapons.
A senior aide to Albright said the sanctions would affect several individuals, two Chinese companies and one Hong Kong company. He did not name the companies or the individuals.
The aide said the sanctions prohibited any imports from these entities to the United States for one year.

In her testimony to the Senate Appropriations Subcommittee on Foreign Operations, Albright said: "We do share your deep concern about what is going on" in the cooperation between China and Iran on weapons-related programmes.
